name: cliqagenda
description: Estrutura Node.js, Express e frontend para o CliqAgenda.

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && npm run migrate --prefix backend && npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
